name: weather-history
description: Past daily observations with a downloadable weather log.
keywords: historical weather by date and location

interface.longDescription:
Weather history for a US city, ZIP code or address and a date range, with daily station observations and an Excel weather log for business records.

Look up daily highs, lows, rain, snowfall, snow depth, average wind and peak gusts. Find reporting stations by coverage in the requested period and distance. Download Excel with Daily, Summary and Source sheets, plus CSV. Adjust rain, snow, heat, freeze and gust thresholds for rain days for construction delay, weather records for insurance claim, or a weather log for job site.

Up to five US sites and 366 days per call, from 1900 through today UTC. Choose a city and state, ZIP code, address or US station ID. Threshold counts exclude missing and quality-flagged values. Trace precipitation is shown as T and contributes zero.

Limits: observations come from a nearby government station and conditions at the site can differ. Daily station records typically appear after two to seven days and can be revised. Some stations report only precipitation and snow; airports mainly supply wind and gust records. Cooperative stations may end the observation day at the reading time, often 7 a.m. Missing days are shown as missing and are not filled in. This is a record of observations, not a certified weather report. Generated files expire in about an hour.

positive.prompt: Weather history for Denver, CO from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 as an Excel and CSV weather log.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_weather_log with the sites and calendar dates requested. Shows station observations with their source and UTC retrieval time. Provides Excel and CSV downloads and distinguishes missing, trace and quality-flagged values.

positive.prompt: Find weather stations near Denver, CO with daily records from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_weather_stations with the sites and calendar dates requested. Shows station observations with their source and UTC retrieval time. Lists station names, coverage, distance and reporting elements.

pl-PL.subtitle: Historia pogody i dzienne dane
pl-PL.description: Sprawdź historyczne pomiary pogody dla miast, kodów pocztowych i adresów w USA. Pobierz dziennik w formacie Excel i CSV. Do pięciu miejsc i 366 dni. Braki danych pozostają puste; warunki na miejscu mogą różnić się od pomiarów stacji.

de-DE.subtitle: Wetterhistorie und Tagesdaten
de-DE.description: Historische Wetterbeobachtungen für US-Orte, Postleitzahlen und Adressen mit Excel- und CSV-Wetterprotokoll. Bis zu fünf Orte und 366 Tage. Fehlende Werte bleiben leer. Die Bedingungen vor Ort können von Stationswerten abweichen.

es-ES.subtitle: Historial y registro del clima
es-ES.description: Consulta observaciones meteorológicas históricas de ciudades, códigos postales y direcciones de EE. UU. Descarga registros Excel y CSV para hasta cinco lugares y 366 días. Los datos ausentes no se completan. Las condiciones locales pueden diferir de la estación.

fr-FR.subtitle: Historique et relevés météo
fr-FR.description: Consultez les observations météo historiques de villes, codes postaux et adresses aux États-Unis. Téléchargez un journal Excel et CSV pour cinq lieux et 366 jours au maximum. Les valeurs manquantes restent vides. Les conditions locales peuvent différer de la station.

ja-JP.subtitle: 過去の天気と日別記録
ja-JP.description: 米国の都市、郵便番号、住所の過去の気象観測を調べ、ExcelとCSVの日別記録を取得できます。最大5地点、366日間。欠測値は補完しません。現地の天候は観測所と異なる場合があります。

pt-BR.subtitle: Histórico e registros do clima
pt-BR.description: Consulte observações meteorológicas históricas para cidades, CEPs e endereços nos EUA. Baixe registros Excel e CSV para até cinco locais e 366 dias. Valores ausentes ficam em branco. As condições no local podem diferir da estação.
